provenance.sourcePrompt:
Left-center-right triptych time-echo split effect packaged over the background video (backgroundVideo). The background video plays normally at full width by default. Five times during the 30-second clip, the frame momentarily splits into three equal columns showing the same video at three different time offsets — creating a temporal echo / parallax-of-time visual effect
SPLIT EVENT design (5 events, each exactly 2.0 seconds)
Event 1: 2.0s–4.0s
Event 2: 7.0s–9.0s
Event 3: 13.0s–15.0s
Event 4: 19.0s–21.0s
Event 5: 25.5s–27.5s
Each event has three phases
IN (0.15s, cubic-bezier easeOut): Two black vertical divider bars slide in from off-screen. Left bar translates from translateX(-100%) to translateX(0) anchored at 33.33% of frame width. Right bar translates from translateX(100%) to translateX(0) anchored at 66.67% of frame width. Simultaneously the three-column split layout fades in (opacity 0→1)
HOLD (1.70s): Three columns visible. Each column is a 33.33%-wide window into the same video source, clipped horizontally
Left column (0%–33.33%): displays backgroundVideo at currentTime (present)
Center column (33.33%–66.67%): displays backgroundVideo at currentTime + 0.3s (near future)
Right column (66.67%–100%): displays backgroundVideo at currentTime + 0.6s (further future)
Implement by: creating three absolutely-positioned video elements all playing the same src. Center video's currentTime = left.currentTime + 0.3, right video's currentTime = left.currentTime + 0.6, synced every requestAnimationFrame tick. Each video is 100% width and clipped with CSS clip-path: inset(0 X% 0 Y%) or overflow:hidden wrapper divs
OUT (0.15s, cubic-bezier easeIn): Both black bars slide back off-screen (reverse of IN). Split layout fades out (opacity 1→0). Full-width single video resumes
BLACK DIVIDER BAR specs
Width: exactly 10px each
Height: 100% of frame
Color: solid #000000
Box-shadow: 0 0 12px rgba(0,0,0,0.5) (soft bloom edge to blend into landscape)
No border radius
Positioned at 33.33% and 66.67% horizontal, full height
z-index above all video layers
FULL-WIDTH DEFAULT state (between events)
Only a single full-width backgroundVideo is visible
The divider bars and split columns are hidden (display:none or opacity:0)
No visual artifacts from the inactive state
TECHNICAL
Use HTML5 video elements. All three share the same video src as backgroundVideo
On each rAF, sync: centerVideo.currentTime = leftVideo.currentTime + 0.3; rightVideo.currentTime = leftVideo.currentTime + 0.6. Clamp to video duration to avoid seeking past end
Keep all videos muted (no audio output from video elements; audio comes from timeline BGM)
Use CSS transform: translateX() for bar animation. Use will-change: transform on bars for smooth GPU animation
Clip column videos using wrapper divs with overflow:hidden and exact pixel-calculated widths based on container
NO text, NO captions, NO labels, NO UI chrome, NO icons, NO energy effects of any kind. The effect is purely geometric and temporal — two thin black lines and three time-offset windows into the same pastoral dreamscape video
